summary.content:
Today's selection covers 99 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 53 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A.I. Chatbots Want Your Health Records. Tread Carefully.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Truecaller now lets you hang up on scammers — on behalf of your family
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 54 articles published in the last 24 hours
